ns2:course.label: Analysis of Adv Instruct Tech
ns2:course.description: This seminar will assist in acquiring expertise with advanced technologies for learning. This includes the design of electronic portfolios (e-portfolios) according to state and national standards, design and application of multimedia in teaching and learning, familiarization with web usability and accessibility, and reflection on the uses of technologies in education. Prerequisite: EPSY 457.
